description:
Connect to the Chinook SQLite database in DBeaver (path: /home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook.db) and create a connection named 'Chinook'.

Write and execute a SQL query to generate a monthly financial KPI report. For every month in the invoices table (from earliest to latest), calculate:
1. Month (format YYYY-MM)
2. Revenue (sum of Total, rounded to 2 decimals)
3. InvoiceCount (count of invoices)
4. UniqueCustomers (count of distinct CustomerIds)
5. NewCustomers (count of customers whose first-ever invoice was in that month)
6. CumulativeRevenue (running total of Revenue from start, rounded to 2 decimals)
7. MoMGrowthPct (Month-over-Month revenue growth %, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL for first month)

Sort results by Month ascending.

Export the results to a CSV file at exactly: /home/ga/Documents/exports/monthly_kpi.csv
Save your SQL script to exactly: /home/ga/Documents/scripts/monthly_kpi.sql
